data.gender_notes: Stearn is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Old English name Stearn is derived from the Old English word stærn, which means ‘strong, firm, steadfast.’ The name was common in England during the Middle Ages and was borne by several saints. In the Christian context, Stearn represents strength, resilience, and unwavering faith. The name Stearn carries the meaning “Strong, Firm, Steadfast” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Stearn usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, firm, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
